# Zekarias M.

Data analyst focused on Python, SQL, dashboards, geospatial analysis, and machine learning.

This portfolio is being rebuilt with Quarto so each project can be presented as a clear analytical case study with methods, findings, artifacts, limitations, and reproducibility notes.

## Featured Work

The first portfolio case studies to migrate are:

- **Atlanta Arts and Entertainment Clustering**: geospatial clustering analysis using Python, APIs, Folium, and K-means.
- **Spatial Health Risk in Kenya**: ArcGIS-based spatial modeling project currently preserved as a PDF artifact.

## Technical Focus

- Python data analysis with pandas, visualization, and reproducible reports
- SQL analysis for business questions and metrics
- Excel and dashboard-based reporting
- Power BI / Tableau-style business intelligence artifacts
- Statistics, model evaluation, and machine learning workflows
- Geospatial analysis using GIS, maps, and spatial data

## Current Build Status

Phase 0 is complete: Quarto renders and publishes successfully to GitHub Pages.
